content:
The Downloads API enables customers to access and download installation and update files for
available Tenable products. You can use the API endpoints to list product pages, list downloads
available for a specific product, and to download a file. The endpoints can also be used to determine
and download the latest version of a file to facilitate the automation of an installation.
Note: The Tenable Downloads API uses a different server URL than the Tenable Vulnerability
Management API:
https://www.tenable.com/downloads/api/v2/pages .
